primary_text: "Every time we bid on something a developer swoops in and outbids us by 200k." It's not a fair fight — and you shouldn't have to compete with cashed-up developers for your own workspace. These off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina are exclusively for owner-occupiers. No investors. No developers. No bidding wars. Just small businesses securing brand-new purpose-built space at a fixed price. 20km from Melbourne CBD near Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel. Finally, a level playing field for business owners who actually need the space.
description: Owner-occupier exclusive — no developers or investors allowed to purchase
